what_this_is: The declared expected state of a freshly built clean-room database.
Every probe below is emitted by supabase/cleanroom/verify.sql as one `key|value` line, and
compared here by supabase/cleanroom/compare.py. The comparison is exact and two-way: a probe
declared here and not emitted is a failure, and a probe emitted and not declared here is also
a failure. Neither file can drift from the other in silence.
The numbers are not aspirations. The historical load was measured on 2026-09-21, before any
fixture residue existed (docs/STATUS.md §2.1, §2.7, §2.7.1, §2.7.7). The Gmail figures were
re-measured on 2026-09-22, after the R1 archived replay batch (§2.7.11) was staged. This file
declares the post-R1 state, because R1 is part of the intended baseline and not a deviation
from it: a build that reproduces only the September twenty is a build that lost a batch.
If a build produces different numbers, either an input changed or the load is not
reproducible, and both are things an operator must see rather than have rounded away.

migrations.count.why: every file in supabase/migrations/, applied and recorded in the ledger. This baseline was left at 21 when the 22nd migration landed, so the first rebuild after it would have failed here rather than silently: that is the check working. origenlab_dev carries 20 recorded with the 21st's DDL already present, which is exactly the drift a clean room exists to avoid.

migrations.head.why: slice3_crm_commercial_case, the newest migration on this branch — the three commercial-case tables.

source_record.total.why: the whole evidence intake: 31 staged Gmail messages plus the 4 migration manifests the historical importer records. Asserted alongside its two parts, never instead of them.

source_record.gmail_message.why: 20 from the September manifest plus 11 from the R1 archived replay batch, each reapplied exactly once from ~/data/origenlab-v2-local/evidence/. The 12th R1 candidate was a bounce, which the loader refuses by rule, so 31 is the number the rules produce rather than the number the mailbox holds.

source_record.migration_manifest.why: written by import_waves_into_v2.py — one per Wave 1A/1B artifact it read.

source_record.gmail_message.pending.why: nothing has been reviewed. A reviewed or promoted Gmail record in a fresh build means a decision was executed that nobody took.

source_record.pytest_residue.why: dedupe_key like 'pytest-%'. The seven fixture records found in origenlab_dev on 2026-09-22.

assertion.total.why: the 11,448 of the historical evidence trail plus the 37 from the two Gmail manifests.

assertion.from_gmail.total.why: 31 contact_address + 6 organization_name, from the 31 staged messages.

assertion.from_gmail.unresolved.why: staging never resolves anything; resolving is a human decision the command boundary records.

assertion.from_gmail.contact_address.why: one asserted sender address per message.

assertion.from_gmail.organization_name.why: asserted only where the message text names an institution — 4 of the 20 September records, 6 names. R1 added none: no archived message names an institution in its own words, and the sender's domain is a routing hint held in the payload, never a claim.

crm.organization.why: promote_evidence_into_crm.py, from uniquely-folded organization_name assertions. All kind='unknown', all machine_proposed.

crm.person.why: no person is ever created from this evidence: it carries no human name, and deriving one from an address local part is an inference, not evidence.

crm.contact_point.attached.why: no contact point carries a person or an organization. A domain is a routing hint, never an identity key (docs/DOMAIN.md §2.2).

crm.domain_event.why: the promotion's audit trail, every row actor_kind='migrator'.

crm.domain_event.with_command_receipt.why: no human command has been executed against this database. The 16 residue events in origenlab_dev are exactly the rows this probe catches.

crm.affiliation.why: an affiliation is a relationship no message header records.

crm.organization_domain.why: no domain has been evidenced as belonging to an institution.

crm.opportunity_organization.why: the commercial-case tables ship empty and stay empty until a command writes one. A requesting institution can only be created by an operator, so a non-zero count here in a fresh build means a decision nobody took.

crm.opportunity_interest.why: no interest is inferred by the build; the historical load carries none.

crm.opportunity_evidence.why: every evidence link names the operator who made it, and the build makes none.

platform.operator.why: one seeded local admin, so the API command boundary can resolve an identity at all. Its auth_user_id belongs to no auth system — Supabase Auth is slice 1.

platform.operator.pytest_residue.why: email_norm like 'pytest-%'. The seven fixture operators found in origenlab_dev on 2026-09-22.

platform.command_receipt.why: no command has been executed. The nine receipts in origenlab_dev are fixture residue, and a clean room starts with none.

comms.mailbox.why: the sending mailbox the historical campaigns belong to.

comms.message.why: no message body has been imported; slice 4.

outbound.campaign.why: Wave 1A, Wave 1B and the archived campaign.

outbound.contact_control.why: the cross-wave safety baseline: prior contacts, address blocks and domain blocks.

outbound.send_control.marketing_enabled.why: false. A clean-room build must never be able to send.
